frequency_question: How often does institutional friction (such as conciliation boards, labor ministry interventions, or court injunctions) completely prevent a called indefinite strike within the designated short window?
membership_rule: Includes industry-wide federation strike calls where formal conciliation or legal intervention occurred prior to the deadline; excludes wildcat strikes or unorganized labor actions.

cases.name: All India Bank Employees Association (AIBEA) / UFBU strike call
Bank union strike notice over settlement

coverage_note: 8 major national financial sector strike calls identified; represents the primary subset of heavily regulated Indian banking and insurance labor federation actions.
known_gaps: Minor regional or single-bank strikes excluded; only industry-wide federation actions included.
multiplier: 8 cases total; 3 hits (strike proceeded despite friction/intervention), 5 misses (strike averted or delayed past deadline due to institutional friction).
validity_reason: Labor laws, conciliation frameworks, and union-management negotiation structures in the regulated banking sector change slowly over multi-year cycles.
